primaryFindings.explanation: The Checkout.totalInCents method now multiplies a double price in dollars by the quantity and casts the result to int, truncating the fractional part. This causes the method to return an incorrect total in cents. For example, with a quantity of 1 the method returns 12 (the integer part of 12.5) instead of the expected 1250 cents, leading to incorrect billing calculations.
